hero.description: Hands-on senior engineer experienced in building frontend systems, digital products, and more autonomous teams.

paragraphs: Hello, I am Leandro. A Senior Software Engineer with more than 10 years of experience on B2B and B2C enterprise projects.
I design scalable frontend architecture, from Piral.js micro-frontends to Turborepo monorepos and modular design systems, backed by strong fullstack experience with Node.js, Fastify, and PostgreSQL.
At Adesso S.p.A., I work on micro-frontend architecture and support engineering teams on complex enterprise projects, with a focus on delivery, quality, and mentoring.
I founded SmartplateMenu, a live multi-tenant SaaS for restaurants, built with Turborepo, Next.js App Router, Fastify, and AI integrations based on n8n and the Claude API.

I integrate AI and LLM systems into production: custom MCP servers, agentic workflows, LangGraph.js, and Vercel AI SDK. Through Codewave.dev, I share technical education and practical content with a developer community.

codewave.title: Codewave.dev: practical education for people building software.
codewave.description: Through Codewave.dev I share learning paths, content, and resources about web development and software careers. It is an education project grounded in daily practice on real products and systems.

paragraphs: In business, the best things to do are simple, but they are always very difficult to do. [W. Buffett]
I enjoy the Forex market. I study technical and fundamental analysis, focusing on EUR/USD, USD/JPY, GBP/USD, GER30, and Dow30.
I work with MetaTrader 4 and TradingView. Books I value include The Trader's Mind and Forex Trading Operations.

I have practised martial arts, especially judo and karate. Today, I mainly train through CrossFit, alongside running and strength work.

content.title: Senior Frontend Architect / AI Specialist, Adesso S.p.A.

⦿ Mentored junior/mid developers, improving their autonomy in delivery.
⦿ Introduced E2E testing with Playwright, bringing coverage from zero on critical flows.
⦿ Configured CI/CD and Kubernetes to ensure reliable deployments and controlled rollbacks.
